{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRCof88AAAABZgR9Lg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn7ElzhDHakQ", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn7El", "number": 71, "title": "Implement IDE READ VERIFY completion addresses and first-error residuals", "body": "## Problem

Ap IDE READ VERIFY commands currently complete through a whole-range check without updating the guest-visible sector count or address. Requests crossing the disk end fail before reporting progress through their valid prefix. DOS software inspecting the task file therefore receives incomplete completion/error information.

## Expected outcome

Implement the legacy READ VERIFY task-file contract for the existing bank-zero master, for both 40h and 41h, in CHS and LBA modes.

Use the documented legacy behavior in [Fujitsu’s disk product manual, READ VERIFY, printed page 5-22](https://www.manualslib.com/manual/54913/Fujitsu-Mhc2032at.html?page=93): successful completion reports the last verified sector and count zero; failure reports the failing sector and the number remaining, including that sector.

The command accepts 1–256 sectors, with input count zero meaning 256; transfers no data to the host; never asserts DRQ; and completes with BSY clear. Out-of-range addresses use the controller’s existing IDNF error. See [T13/1321D revision 3, §8.28](https://www.seagate.com/support/disc/manuals/ata/d1153r17.pdf#page=169). This later draft leaves normal address/count outputs unspecified; the explicit legacy behavior above is this emulator’s selected contract, not a universal ATA requirement.

## Context and reproduction

Inspected baseline: `498870071f182bb5440fdc0c75b609cf34df15c5`; clean worktree. This is source-based planning, with no builds, tests, fixture preparation or repository modifications performed.

- [src/hdd.rs:245](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/498870071f182bb5440fdc0c75b609cf34df15c5/src/hdd.rs#L245): `Ide::command` rejects the entire range before dispatch. The VERIFY branch clears internal `remaining` without changing the task-file count/address.
- [src/hdd.rs:139](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/498870071f182bb5440fdc0c75b609cf34df15c5/src/hdd.rs#L139): the PIO `advance` helper increments the address even after the last sector and may load another data block. Reusing it unchanged would violate this non-data command’s contract.
- [tests/hdd.rs:169](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/498870071f182bb5440fdc0c75b609cf34df15c5/tests/hdd.rs#L169): existing coverage exercises IDENTIFY and PIO read/write, but no VERIFY command. Its zero-count read is cancelled before completion.
- [src/firmware.rs:530](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/498870071f182bb5440fdc0c75b609cf34df15c5/src/firmware.rs#L530): BIOS HDD VERIFY issues single-sector commands and maintains its own address, so existing BIOS success cannot establish multisector task-file correctness.

Reproduction to add: issue VERIFY from LBA 7 with count 3 on an original synthetic HDI. Current source leaves count 3 and address 7; expected completion is count 0 and address 9. For capacity N, start N−2 with count 4: expect IDNF at address N with residual 2.

Scope: implement these completion/error semantics, preserve device/head control bits, and retain existing completion-IRQ/status acknowledgement behavior. Bounded synchronous completion is acceptable. Validated HDI payload has no modeled ECC failures; do not claim physical-media integrity checking.

Non-goals: changing PIO read/write semantics, adding commands, mechanical timing, defective-sector infrastructure, DMA/ATAPI/SCSI/SASI, BIOS redesign, or unrelated refactoring.

Progress retained: PR #70’s CPU diff implements the documented VM segment-interrupt shadow. The [Coordinator’s validation record](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/498870071f182bb5440fdc0c75b609cf34df15c5/docs/validation.md#issue-69-v30-segment-interrupt-inhibition-2026-10-24) reports 288 native integration and 102 production-Wasm browser passes; independent PR review and successful remote CI were not supplied. These are reported results, not evaluator-executed checks. Supplied open Issues are empty, and the supplied improvement history contains no duplicate VERIFY implementation.

All 26 inventory scopes/statuses remain unchanged: **partial** cpu-v30, cpu386, protected-mode, memory, pic, pit, dma, rtc, keyboard, mouse, fdc, ide, gdc, egc, pegc, text-cg, display-timing, opn, opna, pcm86, bios, lio, integration; **implemented_unverified** grcg; **unimplemented** paging, fpu. Protected execution, paging and basic FPU remain required.

IDE remains partial after this Issue. Outstanding acceptance includes completed 256-sector PIO transfers, READ/WRITE final-address and error-residual contracts, and fuller reset, nIEN and device/error interactions. Limited probes and existing game reports do not establish complete hardware accuracy or commercial compatibility.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Add original `ide_verify_` Rust tests using in-memory synthetic HDIs. Record the baseline failures for successful completion and a request crossing the disk end; retain the same expectations after implementation.
- [ ] Cover both opcodes and address modes with counts 1, 2, 255 and 0; CHS head/cylinder transitions; LBA byte carry; and successful completion exactly at the last physical sector. Independently calculate expected task-file bytes.
- [ ] Cover invalid starting CHS/LBA addresses and requests crossing capacity, including a zero-count request with a valid prefix. Assert exact residual/address/error results, BSY/DRQ/ERR state, and recovery through a subsequent valid command.
- [ ] Verify completion IRQ latching, alternate-status reads preserving the device latch, primary-status reads clearing it, and nIEN suppression for VERIFY. Distinguish the device latch from an already latched PIC request. Assert unchanged HDI bytes/write counters and successful subsequent IDENTIFY/read/write operations.
- [ ] Add an original MIT bare-metal guest probe, proposed as `guest/ide_verify.asm`, with an offline preparation command `python3 tools/prepare_ide_verify_fixture.py` and checked provenance manifest. Record sources, license, assembly command, source/image/synthetic-firmware hashes, geometry, exact results/guards and a fixed execution budget. Use no acquired guest software or proprietary firmware.
- [ ] Boot the identical probe natively and through production release-Wasm at both `/` and `/pc98-rust/`, before and after reset. Require guest PASS, exact independently expected results/guards, unchanged media, bounded execution and no emulator/browser errors. Hosts may mount/reset/step/read outputs, but must not manufacture guest results. Wire preparation into existing acceptance CI.
- [ ] Coordinator runs `cargo test --locked --test hdd ide_verify_`, `cargo test --locked --test hdd`, and the complete README reproduction checks: fixture prerequisites, `cargo test --locked`, Clippy with warnings denied, formatting/media/font checks, `git diff --check`, and `npm test`. Preserve existing hardware, DOS/application, VM, audio and six-game assertions and budgets without skips or weakening.
- [ ] Update hardware/validation documentation with the selected legacy contract, exact commands/results, provenance and remaining IDE limitations. Attribute Coordinator/CI evidence accurately; retain every inventory category and scope. Missing evaluator-local assets are not a project-level blocker.

## Optional validation

None.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
